jobs.title: Global Principal Electrical Design Engineer - Data Center Segment
jobs.description: Eaton has been a key player in the Middle East for 40 years. In July 2024, we announced the construction of a new sustainable campus in Dubai, which will bring together our commercial, manufacturing, and support functions, providing room for future growth. About Eaton Eaton is a power management company where we provide energy-efficient solutions that help our customers effectively manage electrical, hydraulic and mechanical power more efficiently, safely and sustainably. Eaton is dedicated to improving the quality of life and the environment through the use of power management technology and services. Eaton has approximately 96,000 employees and sells products to customers in more than 175 countries. Eaton's Global Data Center Segment is focused on helping data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future. With the rise of big data, edge computing and cloud, data centers are under pressure to be more high-performing, sustainable and cost-effective than ever, without compromising resilience or security. At the same time, new opportunities and revenue streams require faster speed-to-market. With our digital intelligence, world-class cyber-secure products and services, reliable, compatible solutions and engineering expertise, we help data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future. Within this segment, Eaton has an opening for a Global Principal Electrical Design Engineer – Data Center Segment. The role serves as Eaton’s senior technical authority for electrical system design across global data center and mission‑critical projects. The role provides strategic and hands‑on engineering leadership from early concept development through detailed design, construction, and project closeout, ensuring technical excellence, safety, compliance, and scalability across global regions. This role influences Eaton’s global electrical design direction, standards, and best practices while supporting complex hyperscale and enterprise data center programs and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, clients, and regional engineering organizations. What You’ll Do Global Electrical Design Authority Act as global subject matter expert and technical authority for electrical systems within Eaton’s Data Centre portfolio. Lead and support the design of complex electrical infrastructure for hyperscale and enterprise data centers from concept through execution. Provide expert guidance on MV and LV distribution, transformers, UPS architecture, protection and coordination, grounding, and system resilience strategies. Standards, Governance & Design Quality Develop, implement, and govern global electrical design standards, reference architectures, and quality frameworks. Ensure all designs align with North American standards (NEC, NFPA, IEEE, UL) and applicable IEC and international standards. Perform peer reviews and validation of electrical engineering deliverables across regions to ensure consistency, compliance, and technical rigor. Serve as final escalation point for complex or high‑risk electrical design challenges. Global Project & Stakeholder Engagement Collaborate within a multidisciplinary global engineering environment on projects of varying complexity and scale. Support bids, proposals, and execution phases by providing advanced electrical engineering expertise. Represent Eaton as a senior technical authority in internal and client-facing meetings, workshops, and design reviews. Participate in global site visits to assess electrical installations, construction quality, and commissioning readiness. Innovation, Value Engineering & Continuous Improvement Lead value engineering initiatives to optimize cost, performance, reliability, and constructability while maintaining system resilience. Evaluate and integrate emerging technologies and architectures in response to increasing power densities, AI/HPC loads, and resilience requirements. Contribute to continuous improvement of global electrical design approaches and delivery models. Knowledge Sharing & Technical Leadership Mentor and support the development of electrical engineering capability across global teams. Promote best practices, technical rigor, and consistent electrical design methodologies across regions and business units. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering from an accredited institution. 10+ years of electrical engineering experience with significant exposure to mission‑critical facilities and data center environments. Skills Deep expertise in MV/LV distribution systems, UPS architectures, transformers, grounding, protection schemes, and system coordination. Strong working knowledge of North American electrical codes (NEC, NFPA, IEEE, UL) and IEC standards. Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior technical authority within global, matrixed organizations. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and clients. Proven capability in program management, change management execution, and governance across global or matrixed organizations. Proven experience operating at a global or enterprise level, supporting multi‑region delivery models. Lead clarification and resolution of complex technical, commercial, and execution issues. Escalate effectively when required, ensuring speed, transparency, and leadership alignment. Ability to travel internationally as required. Strong technical, commercial, and analytical capability. Proven leadership, stakeholder engagement, and cross‑regional collaboration skills. Self‑directed with strong decision‑making and problem‑solving ability Fluent in English with the ability to engage effectively with diverse global teams. What We Offer You Being part of a company that has been in business for more than 100 years, is well known in the industry, and has a major impact on the energy industry Work in a company that is commitment to Inclusion & Diversity and Sustainability Annual mentoring program, Eaton University, a reward, and recognition system Ongoing Learning and Career Development Opportunities in a global company. Build your career and apply internally for our open positions worldwide Strong, agile and diverse team locally and globally Strong processes and state-of-the-art systems and tools Structured employee development processes, open feedback culture with development plans Detailed induction support and well-structured onboarding Balance your work and life with a hybrid worktime model Living and Working in Dubai Dubai is a vibrant, cosmopolitan city known for its modern architecture, luxurious lifestyle, and rich cultural heritage. Living and working in Dubai offers an exceptional quality of life with world-class amenities, a safe environment, and a thriving expatriate community. Experience a dynamic blend of work and leisure in one of the world’s most exciting cities. Ready to make a difference? Join Eaton’s Dubai Team and be part of a company shaping the future of sustainable manufacturing and power management! We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

jobs.title: Senior Energy Consultant
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description: Job Description With over 14,000 professionals globally, GHD is a leading multidisciplinary professional services company delivering engineering, design, and advisory solutions across water, energy, resources, environment, property & buildings, and transportation sectors. Energy Overview Energy systems across the Middle East are evolving rapidly. Strong demand growth, major infrastructure investment, increasing renewable energy deployment and the growing need for storage, flexibility and digital solutions are creating new and complex requirements for how energy is planned, delivered and managed. In response to this transforming landscape, GHD is bringing together regional insight and global technical expertise to help utilities, governments, developers and major energy users address these challenges. Our work spans electricity networks, renewable energy, utility-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS), energy strategy and advisory, technical due diligence, regulatory support, grid integration, demand-side flexibility, and the energy needs of critical sectors such as data centres and water infrastructure, supporting clients throughout the lifecycle of their energy assets and systems. To strengthen GHD’s response and support the continued growth of our Middle East Energy team, we are looking for highly motivated professionals who bring sound technical judgement to help us deliver reliable, resilient, and lower-carbon solutions that create lasting benefits for our communities. Position Overview As a Senior Energy Consultant, you will lead and contribute to GHD’s energy sector work across the Middle East, applying your experience across electricity networks, renewable energy, energy storage, system integration, energy strategy and technical advisory. You will independently deliver and coordinate technical work, integrate multidisciplinary inputs and translate complex engineering matters into clear findings and practical recommendations. Assignments may span feasibility and options studies, network and substation design and delivery, technical and techno-economic assessments, due diligence, Owner’s Engineer services, procurement support and construction-stage services. The role combines technical delivery with project coordination, client engagement, proposal development and the mentoring of junior professionals. Key Responsibilities Contribute to multidisciplinary energy projects across electricity networks, Contribute to the business plan for Energy growth strategy in the Middle East with local leadership. Lead and contribute to business development activities and leading proposals to provide technical support to win and deliver projects. Lead and contribute to multidisciplinary technical workstreams across electricity networks, renewable energy, energy storage, system integration, energy strategy and related infrastructure. Deliver feasibility and options studies, engineering assessments and technical advisory assignments from initial scoping through to final recommendations. Assess project requirements, technical configurations, technology options, operational constraints and interfaces with existing infrastructure. Undertake, review or coordinate relevant technical analyses, including power-system, grid-integration, energy-modelling and techno-economic studies. Support the planning, design and delivery of electricity network and substation projects, including option selection, design coordination, technical specifications, equipment interfaces, procurement and construction-stage input. Review designs, calculations, specifications, equipment data and technical documentation for alignment with project requirements, applicable standards and good industry practice. Deliver technical due diligence and Owner’s Engineer assignments by evaluating technical, delivery and operational risks and developing proportionate recommendations. Coordinate multidisciplinary inputs and engage confidently with clients, utilities, developers, contractors and other project stakeholders. Manage assigned scopes in accordance with agreed programme, budget, quality, governance and health and safety requirements, including serving in a project manager role for projects. Prepare and review clear technical deliverables and support proposals, client development and other business development activities. Mentor junior professionals through technical review, coaching and knowledge sharing. Maintain external relationships with industry peers, OEMs, Contractors, and Clients. Contribute to the consistent application and continuous improvement of technical tools, methods and delivery standards. Experience & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Energy or Power Engineering, or a related discipline. A relevant postgraduate qualification would be advantageous. Minimum of eight (8) years of relevant experience in consulting, utilities, project development, engineering, EPC, Owner’s Engineer or technical advisory environments. Demonstrated technical depth in one or more areas such as electricity networks and substations, renewable energy, energy storage, grid connection, system integration, energy modelling, energy strategy, due diligence or project delivery, together with the ability to coordinate interfaces across disciplines. Ability to interpret complex technical information, identify material issues and develop clear, evidence-based recommendations. Good understanding of relevant international standards and engineering practices. Experience with Middle East utilities, regulatory frameworks or project-delivery environments would be highly regarded. Experience using, reviewing or directing work undertaken with relevant engineering, modelling or data-analysis tools, such as DIgSILENT PowerFactory, ETAP, PSS®E, PSCAD, PLEXOS, Python or similar platforms, as relevant to the candidate’s technical specialism. Strong written, presentation and client-facing communication skills, with the ability to explain complex matters clearly and contribute to proposals and business development. Good interpersonal skills; e.g., relate well to colleagues, clients and business contacts, and can influence them to achieve positive results Strong record of delivering technical excellence Proven experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams, managing concurrent assignments and exercising sound technical, commercial and professional judgement. Chartered Engineer status, or progress towards an equivalent recognised professional accreditation, would be advantageous. Fluency in written and spoken English is required. Occasional regional or international travel may be required. Why Join Us? The opportunity to lead significant energy and infrastructure projects across the Middle East, working directly with utilities, governments, developers, investors and major energy users. Access to GHD’s regional and global specialists across networks, renewables, energy storage, advisory and project delivery. A platform to strengthen your technical leadership, project management and client relationship capabilities. The opportunity to shape GHD’s regional Energy capability Structured professional development, mentoring and opportunities to work towards professional accreditation. An inclusive environment that values collaboration, technical quality and continuous learning. Join a team that values knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and professional excellence. Be part of a workplace that combines collaboration, flexibility, and connection. Join us in the office three days per week to contribute, connect and excel in our vibrant environment.

Our product operates across multiple UAE regulatory frameworks, and we build it with a small, high-ownership, AI-native team. THE OPPORTUNITY Our customers experience Finanshels through accounting, taxation, bookkeeping and more — and today that experience is fragmented, manual, and stitched across disconnected systems. Talented builders are shipping AI-powered solutions against individual pieces of it, at speed, but without a unifying product view of the journey those pieces belong to. This role exists to fix that. You will own the customer experience charter on FinOS: replacing a broken, manual journey with automated, productised, and unified experiences across every stage and every service line. Along the way, you will raise the product bar for how the whole team builds — defining the problem, the user, and the measure of success before engineering begins. This is a hands-on role in a startup. You will start as the sole product owner for this charter, reporting to the Head of Product, with scope to build and lead a product team as the function grows. What You'll Own ▸ The End-to-End Customer Journey . Map, diagnose, and rebuild the customer experience across service lines — from first touch through ongoing delivery — turning manual, fragmented steps into unified, productised flows on FinOS. ▸ Automation at the Core . Identify where human effort is absorbing what the product should do, and drive the automation that removes it — measured in customer effort reduced and operational hours freed. ▸ Consolidation onto One Platform . Bring capability scattered across legacy internal systems into a single coherent experience, so customers and the teams serving them work in one place, not many. ▸ Product Standards for AI-Native Building . Raise how the team builds. Bring rigour — clear problem definition, user clarity, success metrics, and evaluation — to AI features that today ship without it. ▸ Prioritisation and Sequencing. Decide what gets built and in what order. Protect the roadmap from work that does not move the metric, and retire builds that have stopped earning their place. ▸ Product Execution. Own roadmap and releases with Engineering, Delivery, Tax and CX. Set standards for accuracy, security, auditability and approvals. Prioritize by hours saved, reliability, customer impact and cost. ▸ Measurement. Define the metrics that describe a healthy customer journey, instrument them with our data and analytics team, and hold the roadmap accountable to them. OWNERSHIP AND AUTONOMY This role carries a clearly defined charter and the authority to run it. Within that charter you are expected to decide — on scope and sequencing, operating cadence and product rituals, user experience and workflow direction, what the team declines to build, and what gets retired. Tooling and vendor decisions sit with you within an agreed budget. Decisions that shift resources beyond your charter, affect pricing or revenue, or cannot be reversed are made jointly with the Head of Product. Everything else is yours. What We're Looking For ▸ Experience . 8+ years in product management, including a period as an early or founding product hire responsible for establishing the function. ▸ Building the Discipline . A demonstrable track record of moving a team from output to outcomes — introducing product practice where it did not previously exist, and making it stick. ▸ Commercial Judgment. You connect every product decision to a business result — revenue earned, cost removed, or time returned — and can defend the trade-off. ▸ Technical Credibility. Engineers regard you as a peer. You hold your own on architecture and data trade-offs and know when technical debt is the right call. ▸ Customer Obsession. You work close to real users — business owners, accountants, tax consultants — and can translate observed friction into shipped improvement. ▸ Journey and Service Design. Proven ability to diagnose experience failure across a complex, multi-stage, partly manual journey and redesign it as a product. ▸ AI Fluency in Practice. You have shipped AI-powered products to production and can speak credibly to evaluation, guardrails, and how you measured whether it worked. ▸ Communication. You write clearly enough that your strategy documents do not need rewriting, and you influence through evidence rather than authority. ▸ Domain (Preferred). Fintech, accounting, tax, or another regulated or professional-services environment. WHY FINANSHELS ▸ Genuine Ownership . Define the customer experience charter from the ground up. ▸ AI-First Mandate. Applied AI is not a side project — it is how we build. ▸ Lean Team, High Impact . Every person and every decision matters. ▸ Fintech at the Right Moment. Finanshels is at an inflection point, and this role will define how we scale. How To Apply Send your CV, along with anything that shows how you build — a strategy document, a before-and-after journey you rebuilt, or a product you are proud of — to careers@finanshels.com.

jobs.title: Senior Manager – Wealth Operations Reconciliation
jobs.description: Emirates NBD is a market leader across the MENAT (Middle East, North Africa and Türkiye) region with a presence in 13 countries, serving over 20 million customers. The Emirates NBD Group has a total of 853 branches and 4,213 ATMs / SDMs. Emirates NBD is the leading financial services brand in the UAE with a Brand value of USD 3.89 billion. At the bank, we serve our customers and help them realise their financial objectives through a range of banking products and services including retail banking, corporate & institutional banking, Islamic banking, investment banking, private banking, asset management, global markets and treasury, and brokerage operations. We are a key participant in the global digital banking industry, with 97% of all financial transactions and requests conducted outside of our branches. We also operate Liv, the lifestyle digital bank by Emirates NBD. With close to half a million users, it continues to be the fastest-growing digital bank in the region. Senior Manager – Wealth Operations Reconciliation The position will provide dedicated leadership, accountability, governance, and risk oversight for one of the most critical control functions within Wealth Management Operations, while supporting the department's broader objectives of operational excellence, risk reduction, scalability, and sustainable growth. Reconciliation is one of the most critical control functions within Wealth Operations, serving as the primary mechanism for validating the accuracy and completeness of client assets, cash balances, trading activity, settlement records, and custodian positions. Any breakdown in this process can lead to financial losses, client impact, regulatory breaches, audit findings, reputational damage, and management escalation. The importance of reconciliation as a key operational control is also reflected in other operational functions where reconciliation, risk management, reporting, and control oversight are recognized as dedicated support activities. The Wealth business continues to expand in terms of: Assets Under Management (AUM) Number of clients and transactions Product complexity Multi-market and multi-custodian operating model Regulatory and governance expectations Dependence on technology platforms and external service providers As transaction volumes and operational complexity increase, reconciliation activities can no longer be managed effectively as a secondary responsibility within existing teams. The function requires dedicated management oversight to ensure that all cash and stock positions are accurately reconciled, investigated, escalated, and resolved within defined timelines. Currently, reconciliations involve multiple data sources, booking platforms, custodians, settlement systems, and internal ledgers. This increases the likelihood of: Unresolved cash breaks Stock position discrepancies Incorrect asset holdings Delayed exception resolution Control weaknesses Increased operational risk exposure: Accurate reconciliation of all client cash balances Verification of stock and security positions Timely identification of discrepancies Immediate escalation of material exceptions Full transparency of unresolved breaks Own the reconciliation governance framework Monitor control effectiveness Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions Maintain audit-ready documentation and evidence
